directions.title: Quiet editorial profile
directions.composition: Use a close lateral view with the desk and screen on a calm horizontal axis, leaving clean negative space around the seated figure.
directions.rendering_language: Use softly layered gouache with crisp focal edges and restrained, tactile shadow transitions.
directions.silhouette: Keep an open profile silhouette with a clearly readable head, neck, shoulder, forearm, and seated leg shape.
directions.lighting_material: Use cool window daylight across matte clothing and a quiet screen surface, with one restrained warm accent.
directions.signature_detail: Finish the hand-to-desk contact and the boundary between shoulder and screen with deliberate edge control.
directions.design_intent: Make the desk action immediate and composed while keeping the image light enough for a small figure inset.

directions.title: Expressive three-quarter study
directions.composition: Use a compact front three-quarter view with the desk entering diagonally and the screen framing, but not hiding, the face.
directions.rendering_language: Use fine colored-pencil contours under transparent watercolor glazing, with a polished editorial finish rather than sketchy roughness.
directions.silhouette: Build a gently curved shoulder-to-back line and a separated forearm gesture that remains legible at thumbnail scale.
directions.lighting_material: Use soft reflected room light, layered fabric tones, and a muted glass highlight on the monitor.
directions.signature_detail: Give the hand and sleeve cuff precise, natural edges without adding extra objects or symbols.
directions.design_intent: Bring more personality and bodily presence to the same desk action without increasing scene clutter.

directions.title: Layered paper relief
directions.composition: Use a near-orthographic side view organized as two broad interlocking shapes: the seated person and a compact desk-screen unit.
directions.rendering_language: Use refined layered-paper forms with subtle paper grain, clean cut edges, and dimensional but quiet tonal shading.
directions.silhouette: Use broad, continuous shapes with a distinct head-shoulder-arm contour and a compact seated lower-body profile.
directions.lighting_material: Use diffuse skylight and shallow cast shadows that separate paper layers without a dramatic background.
directions.signature_detail: Make the overlaps at the screen frame, forearm, and desk edge especially crisp and intentional.
directions.design_intent: Create a more graphic, crafted read that stays distinctive when reduced inside a dense scientific figure.
